_note: 2025 新增债务限额 for issuers the MOF disclosure platform (celma.org.cn) has not yet published, taken from each region's own official budget documents. Same source policy as data/prov-reports: the region's own gov.cn domain only, no aggregator, news site or commercial database. Each entry records the exact URL and the sentence the figures come from, so any reader can check it. build_prov_debt_panel.py merges these and tags the row quota_source='budget-report'; a figure here never overrides one the platform publishes. Amounts are 亿元.

_fields.url: official source URL on the region's own gov.cn domain
_fields.title: document title
_fields.scope: what the figure covers, e.g. excludes 计划单列市
_fields.note: anything a reader needs to interpret it
_fields.verification: direct = the figure was read from the source document fetched from its official URL. indirect = the host refuses connections from outside mainland China and the document could not be opened, so the figure rests on corroboration; the note says what that is.

entries.title: 关于2025年自治区预算执行情况和2026年自治区预算草案的报告

entries.quote: 2025 年新疆维吾尔自治区新增地方政府债务限额 2093 亿元，具体包括：自治区新增地方政府债务限额 1882 亿元，其中新增一般债务限额 299 亿元、新增专项债务限额 1583 亿元；新疆生产建设兵团新增地方政府债务限额 211 亿元，其中新增一般债务限额 80 亿元、新增专项债务限额 131 亿元。

entries.title: 吉林省人民政府关于提请审议《吉林省发行2025年新增地方政府债券有关情况及预算调整方案（草案）》的议案
entries.venue: 吉林省第十四届人大常委会第十八次会议 · 吉林省财政厅（2025-08-04 公开）
entries.quote: 经国务院同意，2025年，财政部分两批次下达我省新增地方政府债务限额804亿元，其中，一般债务限额221亿元（含政府债务外贷2.28亿元），专项债务限额583亿元。
entries.note: 一般 221 includes 2.28 亿元 政府债务外贷 (foreign-loan on-lending); domestic-only would be 218.72. New general issuance of 220 against a 221 quota is a 99.5% match, which corroborates the figure. New special issuance of 843 against 583 exceeds the allocation, consistent with use of carried-over headroom (结存限额).

entries.title: 广东省人民政府关于2025年省级财政预算调整方案的报告
entries.venue: 广东省第十四届人民代表大会常务委员会第十八次会议 · 广东省财政厅

entries.title: 关于提请审议《江苏省2025年地方政府债务限额及省级预算调整方案（草案）》议案的说明

entries.title: 湖北省人民代表大会财政经济委员会关于2025年省级预算调整方案的审查报告
entries.venue: 湖北省第十四届人民代表大会常务委员会第二十次会议 · 中国湖北人大
entries.quote: 截至目前，财政部正式下达我省新增政府债务限额2141亿元（一般债务419亿元、专项债务1722亿元），比年初预算增加927亿元（一般债务196亿元、专项债务731亿元）。

entries.title: 2025年宁波市政府专项债券（十五至二十四期）信息披露文件
entries.quote: 财政部下达我市2025年新增地方政府债务限额559亿元，其中：一般债务限额16亿元，专项债务限额543亿元。
entries.scope: 全市（计划单列市，不含浙江省其余地区）
entries.corroboration: New general issuance of 16.00 equals the 16 general quota exactly. The February 2025 disclosure states the advance batch as 285（一般5、专项280）, a subset of this figure, not an addition to it.
entries.note: AS OF MID-AUGUST 2025, not a year-end figure. Ningbo's 人大常委会 approved a 2025 budget adjustment on 2025-10-29 tied to the new-debt quota (https://www.nbrd.gov.cn/art/2025/11/4/art_1229575855_43440.html), but the resolution carries no figures and the underlying 说明 is not published, so a Q4 top-up cannot be ruled out. New special issuance of 593 exceeds the 543 quota, which is consistent either with such a top-up or with 结存限额.

entries.title: 关于青岛市2025年预算执行情况和2026年预算草案的报告
entries.venue: 青岛市第十七届人民代表大会第五次会议
entries.quote: 经国务院批准，财政部下达我市2025年政府债务限额755亿元，其中一般债务限额78亿元，专项债务限额677亿元；收回我市政府专项债务限额26亿元。
entries.scope: 全市（计划单列市，不含山东省其余地区）
entries.corroboration: The same report's issuance figures match this repo's own independent parse of the Debt Center bond appendix to the cent: total 1,094.98 (parse 1,094.98), new 730 (parse 730.00), refinancing 222.98 + swap 142 = 364.98 (parse 364.98). Its limit arithmetic also closes exactly: 1,224.45-1,146.45 = 78, 4,230.50-3,579.50 = 651 = 677-26, 5,454.95-4,725.95 = 729.
entries.note: VERIFICATION IS INDIRECT: www.qingdao.gov.cn refuses connections from outside mainland China, so neither this session nor the agent could open the PDF, and there is no Wayback snapshot. The figures come from search-tool readings of that URL across five differently phrased queries returning identical numbers, plus the corroboration above. Entered gross as 下达 (78 + 677 = 755) for consistency with the other entries; 26 亿元 of special limit was recalled, so the net increase in the limit was 729, against which new issuance of 730 is 100.1%.

_validation: Same-measure check: 新疆生产建设兵团 2025 appears in BOTH sources -- the disclosure platform publishes 新增一般债务限额 80 / 新增专项债务限额 131, and the Xinjiang finance department's 2026 budget report states the identical 80 / 131 for the XPCC. So the quota a region reports to the platform and the quota 财政部下达 in its budget report are the same figure, and the two sources can be used in one series. Second check: 深圳市 2025 appears in both sources too -- the platform publishes 15 / 866, and Guangdong's own budget-adjustment report breaks its 5,686 亿元 into 广东地区 305 / 4,500 and 深圳市 15 / 866. The Shenzhen halves match exactly, so Guangdong is entered here on the Shenzhen-excluded basis the platform uses. Third check: the Hubei and Henan documents have 2024 equivalents stating 372/1,661 and 323/1,907, and the platform publishes exactly those figures for 2024. Three independent confirmations that the two sources carry the same measure.
_carryover_note: Why issuance can exceed quota: 结存限额 (unused ceiling carried over from earlier years) is allocated separately and is NOT part of 新增限额. Guangdong received 644 亿元 of it in 2025 (370 of that issued as new special bonds), and Jiangsu a net 119 亿元 (300 for project construction). Those tranches account for the special-bond overshoot in both provinces: Jiangsu issued 2,785 against a 2,485 quota, and 2,785-2,485 = 300 exactly. Execution above 100% in this series therefore means carried-over headroom was used, not that a quota was breached.
